advertising.placement: top and bottom on content pages; left and right on initial viewport widths of at least1440px; legal pages and404 excluded
advertising.loading: sequential parser-inserted provider scripts in the page document; side slots do not request ads on narrower viewports

native.placement: once at the end of content before the footer; legal pages and 404 excluded
native.loading: asynchronous, directly in the page, data-cfasync=false

popunder.loading: No component, script tag or click initialization handler.
popunder.exclusions: legal pages, 404, previews, initial consent/settings clicks and clicks inside ad slots
popunder.policyReference: Google prohibits its ads on sites that contain or trigger popunders; remove popunder before using AdSense.
